You can then add an Events folder for special occasions within each month, such as 2024/06/Summer_Camp or 2024/12/Christmas. Keep filenames short and descriptive, but don’t overthink it—let the dates and folder names do the work.

Burning to DVDs is off the table—understood. For a folder structure that keeps photos findable, try a simple Year > Month > Event hierarchy. It’s intuitive, scales well, and avoids long scrolling lists. For example, 2024 > 06 > BeachTrip. Keep it consistent, and you’ll locate anything in seconds.
